title: Really cute
text: Really cute. I put these on 5 decent sized windows and they are so cute! I’ll be getting these every year (for as long as they sell them).

product_metadata.title: 113 PCS Christmas Snowflake Window Cling Stickers Christmas Window Clings for Glass Windows Xmas Decals Decorations Holiday Snowflake Santa Claus Reindeer Decals for Party
features: Package Includes: 113 pieces of Christmas window stickers include 85 snowflake/white dots, and other Christmas elements, such as Santa Claus, reindeer, bells, snowman, Christmas trees, "Merry Christmas", Christmas stockings, etc., perfect for Christmas Window decorations, adding a touch of festive glamour to your windows.
Leave NO Marks: This kind of static clings are used with no glue, they stick by themselves, removable and repositionable with no residue, then peel off without damaging the glass OR the cling!

Double-sided Printing: The Christmas snowflake window clings are double-sided print, and both sides can be attached. After decorating your windows, you can see these cute Christmas window decals whether on the inside or outside.

Easy to Use: Each pattern of these Christmas Window decor is separated, no need to cut, they are easy to peel off from the backing paper, just spray little water on the window, then put them on the surface, they will stick all by themselves! You can freely combine, try and adjust as much as you want to compose a perfect picture, it will works well for a long time.

Where to Display: Our Christmas snowflake window stickers can be used on a variety of smooth surfaces, such as windows, glass doors, mirrors, ceramic tiles, mugs, bathtubs and refrigerators, etc. One set can be decorated many places.
